The sequences, source pins and measurements below record successive historical implementations, not instructions to repeat their branch operations or rebuild delivered work. The silhouette/contact and relief follow-ups supersede the initial compound-profile representation; [world presentation](../world-presentation.md) owns current behavior. The supplied [mercenary pilot](completed/mercenary-scene-pilot.md) is now integrated under SW18.14. Its separate evidence does not qualify the combined model/eight-fire/3× workload or close the remaining cold-start, frame-time and physical-device checks.
Completion requires the full-resolution change, recorded sustained measurements and visual scenarios, fixes to discovered in-scope issues, focused existing camera/spatial checks, typecheck/build/format, affected-diff review and reconciled behavior/limits/evidence. The actual 3D model pilot was deferred at this checkpoint until the supplied asset arrived; SW18.14 subsequently delivered it. Retain that separation when interpreting these earlier sprite-only measurements. Physical low-end hardware remains a reported access limitation, not a simulated pass.
Sustained smoothness is not fully accepted: the production UI run recorded an intermittent 445.9 ms frame interval/438.1 ms renderer bracket despite low typical costs. Repeating its Detailed→Economy sequence reproduced the hitch; temporary WebGL instrumentation attributes 308.3 ms to synchronous shader linking on first draw, rather than GC or steady shadow drawing. A short accelerated orbit did not reproduce it, so a blanket camera sweep is not an established fix. The pinned forward renderer forces synchronous finalization; skipping draws while compiling would risk visible objects/depth/shadows. No engine monkey patch is adopted. At that checkpoint SW18.13 remained partial, with shader preparation tracked in SW18.10. The follow-up below addresses that attributed hitch; cold loading and other frame-time tails still prevent uninterrupted-60-Hz acceptance. [Full-HD evidence](../verification/shadow-1080p.md) owns measured cases and limits. SW18.14 subsequently delivered the supplied model; physical low-end GPU access, combined-model performance and broader asset/receiver qualification remain separate open items.
4. Run focused static/build checks, inspect the full affected diff and update SW18.10/SW18.13 and verification evidence. Completion requires the demonstrated shader hitch addressed without a visual regression. The actual-model pilot was outside this shader-fix scope and is now delivered separately under SW18.14.
Authorized 2026-09-27: optimize until the available hardware supports eight illuminating, shadow-casting fires with actual 3× game progress at full 1920×1080. The first hardware target is the existing Apple M1 Pro/Chromium ANGLE Metal. Working acceptance is sustained 60 Hz: record display-paced frame intervals, render CPU/GPU p50/p95/p99/max, stalls over 50 ms, actual game seconds per wall second, commands/publication and all eight selected lights. Do not infer simulation throughput from synthetic moving sprites or requested speed. The then-deferred real-model pilot was subsequently delivered under SW18.14; this sprite-focused workload does not qualify its combined performance.
[Follow-up evidence](../verification/command-frame-spikes.md) records 424 exact query comparisons, 1,488 matching full command transitions and repeat isolated preview CPU reductions of about 40%. The real 1080p dusk run retains eight fires and successful commands, but reaches only 2.385× under severe host contention. Reliable whole-game tail improvement and physical lower-end testing remain incomplete; no usable second device has been supplied. Shared-output interference was removed by moving the temporary benchmark build to a private directory. The floor-hearing test failure was reproduced on the original code at that checkpoint. The later [October 1 fixture correction](../verification/hearing-main-integration.md#floor-hearing-regression--october-1-2026) repairs those obsolete sight-barrier and speech-origin assertions without changing production acoustics; that specific SW08 regression is no longer an open blocker. HE05 retains broader hearing qualification. The plan remains partially delivered because the narrower route-query gains do not establish whole-game tail improvement or physical lower-end performance.
